# InHype Sanctuary Medical Spa Glendale

> Physician supervised medical spa in downtown Glendale, California, open since 2019.
> Medical director: Dr. Kevin Do, MD, graduate of the USC Keck School of Medicine.

## Treatments
- Tirzepatide and other GLP therapy with physician supervision, offered as monthly membership plans
- NAD+ injections
- Peptide therapy
- LPG Endermologie and lymphatic drainage
- Morpheus8 for face and body
- Forma, Lumecca and Evolve
- Laser hair removal
- Compression therapy

Every plan starts with a consultation. Membership plans and current pricing: https://www.inhypesanctuary.com/

## Location
110 E Wilson Ave, Glendale, CA 91206
Downtown Glendale, near the Glendale Galleria. Free garage parking.

## Hours
Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Saturday and Sunday closed. By appointment.
